comparison_note: ACROSS GRAINS. The OLS is fitted on CELLS; the display smoother it replaces was fitted on UNITS. Both are evaluated at the units' own water values, so this compares two expectations at the same place - but any divergence is confounded with grain and is NOT evidence on its own that the linear form is inadequate. Section 6.2's ladder is what separates them.
